mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_hr_audit_archive(id,tenant_id,action,actor_id,subject_ref,department_id,occurred_at,archived_at) SELECT a.id,a.tenant_id,a.action,a.actor_id,a.subject_ref,a.department_id,a.occurred_at,#{now} FROM ai_hr_audit a WHERE a.occurred_at<=#{before} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_hr_audit_archive c WHERE c.id=a.id AND c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_hr_audit WHERE occurred_at<=#{before} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_hr_audit_archive c WHERE c.id=ai_hr_audit.id AND c.tenant_id=ai_hr_audit.tenant_id)
